text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The deserted island project! The 
Umamusume's very first task was—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Time to pioneer!

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Ooh!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, staying overnight on an uninhabited 
island! I bet I'll have some great stories 
to tell my little sisters~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm knocking down this palm tree! 
Watch out! —Heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (THUUUD!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! I see, so that's how you cut down 
trees...! Taking notes!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Chiyo, did you put on sunscreen? 
Mine is SPF 50, want some? It feels light 
and it's waterproof."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho! Hehe! ...Huh, Tamamo-san?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Gasp, wheeze! Isn't this brutal!? How can 
you look so nonchalant about it...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Well, knowing it's working my biceps just 
naturally fills me with strength! If you'd 
like, shall I carry yours too, Tamamo-san?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm totally fine! I've got the guts of a 
true Naniwa Umamusume! Nuooh!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
At first, having no signal on my phone was 
pretty rough... but once you get used to 
it, it's not so bad.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, maybe City-chan got a bit too 
caught up in the city life, huh?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Might as well stretch out and relax here. 
If you're bored, I can keep you company♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The pioneering work progressed in high 
spirits. However—a few days later, an 
incident occurred!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm so hungry~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Are the supplies not here yet? They 
haven't arrived due to transport trouble, 
so Tucker-san, the only one who can pilot, 
scrambled a helicopter—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"I am so, so sorry! I'll carry the rice 
and water and be right back! Don't you 
guys go doing anything dangerous, okay?!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Quite some time has passed since then, 
hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Now that you mention it, they really are 
taking a while. I hope they're okay... I 
heard their food supplies are about to run 
out soon too..."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, this is bad! I just got a 
transmission from Tucker-san...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"The weather over there is super bad, and 
the helicopters can't fly anymore...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Does that mean—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: No food... for a while...!

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I want to go back to Tracen Academy...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I wonder if it'll clear up tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Who knows. I don't think it'll be that 
long, though. Haaah, staying overnight 
really came back to bite me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm back. ...No good, nothing's biting at 
all!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, me too... There was a river, but I 
didn't know if the water was drinkable.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Not at all, thank you both so much...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"The sun is setting soon anyway, so let's 
just stay put in the tent for now. The 
golden rule of being stranded: stay where 
you are!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right... Guess we should save 
our stamina for now...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (...*dead silence*...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... Once you lie down, your body 
feels pretty heavy, doesn't it...!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I'll even be able to get out 
of bed tomorrow... Maybe I should just... 
retire like this... Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (...*dead silence*...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ………… ……This might be seriously bad.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Heh. ...Hehe, hehehe. Hahaha... 
hahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!! Zero food left? Bring it on, I 
say!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, Tamamo-senpai's gone completely 
loopy.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The hell it is! It ain't that I'm used to 
starvin'— I actually get more power when 
my stomach's empty!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm rarin' to go! Sis— I'll handle this 
somehow, so just sit tight and watch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tamamo Cross dashed across the sea 
and the hills—!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nwooooh! If fishing won't work, I'll catch 
'em with my bare hands!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH! Where's the edible fruit, come 
out already! The others are waitin' for me 
over there!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Don't look down on someone from the slums— 
Ah! Something to eat over there!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Grub, grub, gimme gruuub! Who cares if 
there's nothin' left, bring it oooon!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoa, incredible. You're blasting off 
like it's a real race...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You sure have plenty of stamina, 
Tamamo-san! ...Or maybe it's sheer 
willpower?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Earlier, Tamamo-san referred to 
herself as 'Big Sister.'"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she's been supporting her 
family like that since way back then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, maybe so.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wanna collect them together with me? 
Somehow... I feel like I can't afford to 
lose.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Coconuts, tree nuts, and whole roasted 
fish! Man, thanks to you, we managed to 
gather a whole bunch!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well then, with gratitude for this life... 
let's eat!

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh, I'm comin' back to life...! 
Tamamo-san, thank you sho much~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That was such incredible grit...! I just 
withered away and couldn't run at all. I'm 
so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It don't matter none— whoever's able to 
move should just do it.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Besides, ya know... whenever I've been 
starvin' since way back, there's kinda 
this good feelin' too, like my instincts 
are stirrin' up inside.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hunting instincts...? It's like this deep, 
roaring power is being awakened from the 
bottom of my stomach.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It felt even more like that today for some 
reason~. I wonder why?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Isn't it because it's an uninhabited 
island? Maybe your instincts were 
awakened.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I see...!? What a fascinating story!! 
*scribble scribble*...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I see, you got swallowed up by the 
atmosphere— Wait, ya idiot! It ain't that 
simple!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ain't the fish about done grilling? 
Sis, try eating first, an'—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You're letting the atmosphere get to you, 
Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Nwah!

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft! Ahahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh, me, the leader bringing the Umamusume 
together!?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Yo! I'm really sorry about the other day! 
I heard you really stepped up and shone 
back then!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Working on a deserted island is grueling! 
Lead everyone with your example!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
O... Ooh! If that's the case, leave it to 
me! I'll do an absolute bang-up job!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with renewed determination! The 
deserted island project moved forward!
